# Future Ammunition - TMT

`ghost_fa_tmt`

Future Ammunition in the TMT magazines the ghost factions issue: each one loaded with the FA round of its calibre, at tiers 2-4, in a ghost well the mod's weapons take. Written by `tools/gen_mod_factions.py`.

- `ace_ballistics` _(external)_
- `ghost_fa_ammo`
- `ghost_fa_tiers`
